In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

mm: swap: fix potential buffer overflow in setup_clusters()

In setup_swap_map(), we only ensure badpages are in range (0, last_page]. 
As maxpages might be < last_page, setup_clusters() will encounter a buffer
overflow when a badpage is >= maxpages.

Only call inc_cluster_info_page() for badpage which is < maxpages to fix
the issue.

En el kernel de Linux, se ha resuelto la siguiente vulnerabilidad:

mm: swap: solucionar un posible desbordamiento de búfer en setup_clusters()

En setup_swap_map(), solo nos aseguramos de que las badpages estén en el rango (0, last_page]. Como maxpages podría ser < last_page, setup_clusters() encontrará un desbordamiento de búfer cuando una badpage sea >= maxpages.

Solo llamar a inc_cluster_info_page() para badpage que sea < maxpages para solucionar el problema.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

crypto: ccp - Fix dereferencing uninitialized error pointer

Fix below smatch warnings:
drivers/crypto/ccp/sev-dev.c:1312 __sev_platform_init_locked()
error: we previously assumed 'error' could be null

En el kernel de Linux, la siguiente vulnerabilidad ha sido resuelta:

crypto: ccp - Soluciona la desreferenciación de puntero de error no inicializado

Soluciona las siguientes advertencias de smatch:
drivers/crypto/ccp/sev-dev.c:1312 __sev_platform_init_locked()
error: anteriormente asumimos que 'error' podría ser nulo

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

NFS: Fix filehandle bounds checking in nfs_fh_to_dentry()

The function needs to check the minimal filehandle length before it can
access the embedded filehandle.

En el kernel de Linux, la siguiente vulnerabilidad ha sido resuelta:

NFS: Corregir la comprobación de límites del filehandle en nfs_fh_to_dentry()

La función necesita comprobar la longitud mínima del filehandle antes de que pueda acceder al filehandle incrustado.

kernel complains sometimes that f2fs_release_decomp_mem() calls
vm_unmap_ram() from an invalid context. Example trace from
f2fs/007 test:

This patch modifies in_task() check inside f2fs_read_end_io() to also
check if interrupts are disabled. This ensures that pages are unmapped
asynchronously in an interrupt handler.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

wifi: ath11k: fix sleeping-in-atomic in ath11k_mac_op_set_bitrate_mask()

ath11k_mac_disable_peer_fixed_rate() is passed as the iterator to
ieee80211_iterate_stations_atomic(). Note in this case the iterator is
required to be atomic, however ath11k_mac_disable_peer_fixed_rate() does
not follow it as it might sleep. Consequently below warning is seen:

BUG: sleeping function called from invalid context at wmi.c:304
Call Trace:
 <TASK>
 dump_stack_lvl
 __might_resched.cold
 ath11k_wmi_cmd_send
 ath11k_wmi_set_peer_param
 ath11k_mac_disable_peer_fixed_rate
 ieee80211_iterate_stations_atomic
 ath11k_mac_op_set_bitrate_mask.cold

Change to ieee80211_iterate_stations_mtx() to fix this issue.

Tested-on: WCN6855 hw2.0 PCI WLAN.HSP.1.1-03125-QCAHSPSWPL_V1_V2_SILICONZ_LITE-3.6510.30

En el kernel de Linux, la siguiente vulnerabilidad ha sido resuelta:

wifi: ath11k: corregir sleeping-in-atomic en ath11k_mac_op_set_bitrate_mask()

ath11k_mac_disable_peer_fixed_rate() se pasa como el iterador a ieee80211_iterate_stations_atomic(). Tenga en cuenta que en este caso se requiere que el iterador sea atómico, sin embargo, ath11k_mac_disable_peer_fixed_rate() no lo sigue ya que podría dormir. Consecuentemente, se observa la siguiente advertencia:

ERROR: función en suspensión llamada desde un contexto inválido en wmi.c:304
Traza de Llamada:
 <TAREA>
 dump_stack_lvl
 __might_resched.cold
 ath11k_wmi_cmd_send
 ath11k_wmi_set_peer_param
 ath11k_mac_disable_peer_fixed_rate
 ieee80211_iterate_stations_atomic
 ath11k_mac_op_set_bitrate_mask.cold

Cambiar a ieee80211_iterate_stations_mtx() para solucionar este problema.

Probado en: WCN6855 hw2.0 PCI WLAN.HSP.1.1-03125-QCAHSPSWPL_V1_V2_SILICONZ_LITE-3.6510.30

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

team: replace team lock with rtnl lock

syszbot reports various ordering issues for lower instance locks and
team lock. Switch to using rtnl lock for protecting team device,
similar to bonding. Based on the patch by Tetsuo Handa.

En el kernel de Linux, la siguiente vulnerabilidad ha sido resuelta:

team: reemplazar el bloqueo de team con el bloqueo rtnl

syszbot informa de varios problemas de ordenación para los bloqueos de instancias inferiores y el bloqueo de team. Cambiar al uso del bloqueo rtnl para proteger el dispositivo team, similar a bonding. Basado en el parche de Tetsuo Handa.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

Revert "fs/ntfs3: Replace inode_trylock with inode_lock"

This reverts commit 69505fe98f198ee813898cbcaf6770949636430b.

Initially, conditional lock acquisition was removed to fix an xfstest bug
that was observed during internal testing. The deadlock reported by syzbot
is resolved by reintroducing conditional acquisition. The xfstest bug no
longer occurs on kernel version 6.16-rc1 during internal testing. I
assume that changes in other modules may have contributed to this.

En el kernel de Linux, la siguiente vulnerabilidad ha sido resuelta:

Revertir 'fs/ntfs3: Reemplazar inode_trylock con inode_lock'

Esto revierte el commit 69505fe98f198ee813898cbcaf6770949636430b.

Inicialmente, la adquisición condicional de bloqueo fue eliminada para corregir un error de xfstest que fue observado durante pruebas internas. El interbloqueo reportado por syzbot se resuelve al reintroducir la adquisición condicional. El error de xfstest ya no ocurre en la versión de kernel 6.16-rc1 durante pruebas internas. Asumo que cambios en otros módulos pueden haber contribuido a esto.

Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in ash-project ash allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.

This issue affects ash: from 0.1.1 before 3.5.39.

Una vulnerabilidad de autorización incorrecta en ash-project ash permite la explotación de niveles de seguridad de control de acceso configurados incorrectamente. Esta vulnerabilidad está asociada con los archivos de programa lib/ash/actions/create/bulk.ex, lib/ash/actions/destroy/bulk.ex, lib/ash/actions/update/bulk.ex y las rutinas de programa 'Elixir.Ash.Actions.Create.Bulk':run/5, 'Elixir.Ash.Actions.Destroy.Bulk':run/6, 'Elixir.Ash.Actions.Update.Bulk:run'/6.

Este problema afecta a ash: desde pkg:hex/ash antes de pkg:hex/ash@3.5.39, antes de 3.5.39, antes de 5d1b6a5d00771fd468a509778637527b5218be9a.

A flaw has been found in Portabilis i-Educar up to 2.10. This affects an unknown part of the file /enturmacao-em-lote/. This manipulation causes improper access controls. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. Upgrading to version 2.12 is able to mitigate this issue. Patch name: d53365e5656f6499a4deddf89d522814655f769d. You should upgrade the affected component.

A vulnerability has been found in Portabilis i-Educar up to 2.10. This vulnerability affects unknown code of the file /cancelar-enturmacao-em-lote/. Such manipulation leads to improper access controls. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. Upgrading to version 2.12 is able to resolve this issue. The name of the patch is d53365e5656f6499a4deddf89d522814655f769d. The affected component should be upgraded.

A vulnerability was found in Portabilis i-Educar up to 2.10. This issue affects some unknown processing of the file /matricula/[ID_STUDENT]/enturmar/. Performing a manipulation results in improper access controls. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. Upgrading to version 2.11.0 is capable of addressing this issue. It is suggested to upgrade the affected component. The vendor confirms: "The reported attack vector was tested against the corrected code, and the previously described improper access control behavior could no longer be reproduced."
